reason: Upload-only official API (https://yandex.ru/dev/autoru/doc/ru/concepts/access): Auto.ru Business API (apiauto.ru/1.0) is publicly documented for dealer accounts; token obtained from Auto.ru manager; XML/JSON feeds also supported. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
